def similar_elements(list1, list2):
    """
    Returns a set containing elements shared between two lists that sit at the same index.
    
    Args:
        list1 (iterable): First collection of items.
        list2 (iterable): Second collection of items.
        
    Returns:
        set: A set of common elements found in both inputs at corresponding positions.
    """
    # Determine the length up to which we can compare indices
    min_len = min(len(list1), len(list2))
    
    shared_elements = []
    for i in range(min_len):
        if list1[i] == list2[i]:
            shared_elements.append(list1[i])
            
    return set(shared_elements)
